Thanks,

Hannah — quick question for forecast: for deals where we are offering a start-of-term credit to accelerate contract signature (e.g., month 1 free / $X credit), should Finance treat the full ARR as committed and amortize the credit, or should we net the credit out of the committed ARR for the quarter? This will materially affect the Q2 committed ARR number for Skyline.

If you prefer, I can model both scenarios and drop the two-line summary into the template.

David — thanks for calling that out. Please model both: (A) gross ARR with amortized credit and (B) net ARR after credit. Finance should publish the two-line impact on the template. For committing the number to the forecast, we will use the net ARR figure (scenario B) so the committed ARR reflects cash expected in the quarter.

Marissa — since CS is ready to start 2027-03-08 with a signed SOW by 2027-02-24, you can mark Skyline as "Commit" once you receive an explicit confirmation email from Sara or a signed SOW. If you get only verbal, mark it "Commit - pending PO" and include the expected PO date.

I’ll schedule a 30m alignment tomorrow (Tue 2/23) at 9:00am PT to finalize the numbers and capture any finance assumptions. Please accept the calendar invite I just sent. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/RW-EXP-4529 — Live template and playbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cDqZ-SkylinePlaybook
